name: Coarse-to-Fine Optimization with Pruning
aliases: Plenoxel Grid with Trilinear Interpolation Optimization
summary: Coarse-to-Fine Optimization with Pruning is a hierarchical training strategy for 3D radiance fields that dynamically adapts voxel structures to scene complexity by pruning unoccupied regions and iteratively refining detail, distinguishing it from static grid methods.
